title: Solebury Home Watch Services
deck: An owl on the roof, keeping watch while you're away.
role: Brand development, web design and copy
lede: A home watch service looks after houses while their owners are away. Its new mark says so in one image: an owl keeping watch from the roof.
challenge: Solebury Home Watch Services is a licensed, insured home watch service in Bucks County, Pennsylvania, that looks after houses while their owners are away. It needed a logo, a brand, a website and the words to go on it.
work: An owl is the one who stays awake while the house sleeps. Set on the ridge of a roof, it reads at a glance as a home being watched over, and it holds up from a van door to a favicon. The emblem comes in tall, stacked and wide versions, in blue, in white on navy and in black.

The website keeps everything on one page: the services, what clients say and the owner's story. For a business that holds the keys to other people's houses, trust is the product, so the page leads with it. It opens on “Peace of mind while you're away” and then lists the services plainly: property checks, mail and packages, storm monitoring, plant care and more. The copy was written alongside the design.
system: Services, testimonials and the owner, on one page.
credits: Dalton Corr: logo and emblem, brand development, website design, copywriting
